import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import statsmodels.api as sm

# 1. Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
muts = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', low_memory=False)
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Compute TMB per patient
tmb = muts.groupby('patient_id').size().reset_index(name='TMB')

# 3. Extract PDCD1 expression (using Ensembl ID prefix) and collapse to patient level
ens_prefix = 'ENSG00000188389'
matches = expr.index[expr.index.str.startswith(ens_prefix)]
if matches.empty:
    raise KeyError(f'No expression row starting with {ens_prefix}')
pdcd1_id = matches[0]
print(f"Using PDCD1 Ensembl ID: {pdcd1_id}")
pd1_series = expr.loc[pdcd1_id]
# Map sample barcodes to patient IDs
pd1_series.index = pd1_series.index.str[:12]
pd1 = pd1_series.groupby(pd1_series.index).mean().rename('PDCD1_expr').reset_index()
pd1.columns = ['patient_id', 'PDCD1_expr']

# 4. Merge TMB and PDCD1 expression
data = pd.merge(tmb, pd1, on='patient_id')

# 5. Add clinical covariate: age_at_diagnosis
clin_sub = clin[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'age_at_diagnosis']].rename(columns={'bcr_patient_barcode': 'patient_id'})
data = pd.merge(data, clin_sub, on='patient_id', how='inner')

# 6. Compute log2(TMB + 1)
data['log2_TMB1'] = np.log2(data['TMB'] + 1)

# 7. Scatter plot with regression line
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
sns.regplot(x='log2_TMB1', y='PDCD1_expr', data=data,
            scatter_kws={'s': 30, 'alpha': 0.6}, line_kws={'color': 'red'})
plt.xlabel('log2(TMB + 1)')
plt.ylabel('PDCD1 expression')
plt.title('PDCD1 vs log2(TMB+1)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 8. Correlation tests
pearson_r, pearson_p = pearsonr(data['log2_TMB1'], data['PDCD1_expr'])
spearman_r, spearman_p = spearmanr(data['log2_TMB1'], data['PDCD1_expr'])
print(f"Pearson r = {pearson_r:.3f}, p = {pearson_p:.3e}")
print(f"Spearman rho = {spearman_r:.3f}, p = {spearman_p:.3e}")

# 9. Linear regression: PDCD1_expr ~ log2_TMB1 + age_at_diagnosis
reg_data = data.dropna(subset=['age_at_diagnosis'])
model = smf.ols('PDCD1_expr ~ log2_TMB1 + age_at_diagnosis', data=reg_data)
res = model.fit()
print(res.summary())

# 10. Diagnostic plot: residuals vs fitted values
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
fitted = res.fittedvalues
residuals = res.resid
plt.scatter(fitted, residuals, s=20, alpha=0.6)
plt.axhline(0, color='red', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Fitted values')
plt.ylabel('Residuals')
plt.title('Residuals vs Fitted')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 11. Display sample of merged data
print("\nSample of merged data:")
print(data[['patient_id', 'TMB', 'log2_TMB1', 'PDCD1_expr', 'age_at_diagnosis']].head())
